object: S9 FQHE degenerate-frame and result-ledger correction
status: committed amendment required before one corrected rerun
scope: numerical instrument and evidence reporting only

prior_record.preservation_rule: The initial artifact and envelope remain byte-for-byte unchanged. The corrected rerun writes new files and cannot retroactively confirm the initial run.

observed_instrument_defects.observation: The first two levels were degenerate to 1.58e-13, and ARPACK returned individually accurate vectors with maximum Gram defect 0.832.
observed_instrument_defects.impact: S9-G5 failed even though the returned low-energy span had small residuals.

observed_instrument_defects.observation: The runner replaced coarse G5-G9 results with NOT_RUN when 9x9 was blocked, then treated pass=false for NOT_RUN as an observed failure.
observed_instrument_defects.impact: The top-level ledger emitted five false kill labels and lost the true coarse gate states.

observed_instrument_defects.observation: The runner required both target meshes before any gauge attack.
observed_instrument_defects.impact: It skipped the preregistered local U(2) attack on the completed 7x7 frame.

observed_instrument_defects.observation: The first envelope described two target meshes even though only one target mesh was measured and duplicated the manifest digest in input_hashes.
observed_instrument_defects.impact: The evidence scope was broader than the executed target.

authorized_numerical_correction.name: deterministic full-Ritz-span QR plus Rayleigh-Ritz
authorized_numerical_correction.input: Exactly the same k=3 vectors returned by the single declared ARPACK call.
steps: Compute reduced QR X_raw = Q R on the complete three-vector returned Ritz span.
Require numerical rank three and record the largest principal-angle sine between the raw and Q spans.
Form the 3x3 Hermitian projected matrix H_RR = Q^dagger H Q.
Form X = Q Y, sort by the recomputed ascending Ritz values, and recompute all residual and Gram diagnostics.
invariants: The corrected vectors span the same three-dimensional Ritz subspace as the raw return up to numerical roundoff.
No eigensolver retry or adaptive change is allowed.
All three eigenvalues, including E2 used by the isolation gap, come from the same corrected Rayleigh-Ritz frame.
The correction is applied identically at every target twist point.
authorized_numerical_correction.failure: Rank loss, non-finite output, excessive span defect, or failure of the recomputed G5 thresholds is an evaluated instrument failure.

corrected_execution_and_ledger.controls: Rerun all original controls before the target.
corrected_execution_and_ledger.confirmation_rule: Run 9x9 only if every coarse G5-G9 gate passes, exactly as in the original preregistration.
corrected_execution_and_ledger.gauge_rule: Run 32 local U(2) attacks on each completed target mesh independently. A coarse attack is telemetry when H1 is already killed; it cannot authorize H3 or C/2.
corrected_execution_and_ledger.per_mesh_rule: Preserve the evaluated G5-G9 state for each measured mesh. Never replace an evaluated coarse state because a later mesh was not admitted.
corrected_execution_and_ledger.aggregate_rule: An aggregate gate is FAIL only when an executed required measurement failed. Missing downstream measurements are NOT_RUN or INCOMPLETE.
corrected_execution_and_ledger.kill_rule: Emit a kill label only for an actual FAIL state, never merely because pass is false or a gate was not run.

hypothesis_rule.S9-FQH-H1: KILLED on any evaluated G5-G7 failure; CONFIRMED only after both meshes pass; otherwise INCOMPLETE or INCONCLUSIVE.
hypothesis_rule.S9-FQH-H2: Evaluated only after H1 passes. Otherwise NOT_RUN; no C/2 label is emitted.
hypothesis_rule.S9-FQH-H3: KILLED only by an executed gauge-attack failure. Without both admitted meshes it remains INCOMPLETE even if the coarse attack passes.

envelope_requirements: Bind both unique manifest digests exactly once.
Describe only the target meshes actually measured.
Record configured budgets separately from observed elapsed and peak resident memory.
Link the initial artifact digest and this correction amendment.

expected_decision: The correction may repair G5 but is not allowed to rescue G6. If W/Delta remains at or above one, retain KILLED_PARAMETER_POINT, stop before 9x9, emit no C/2 label, and perform no tuning.
interpretation_ceiling: A corrected numerical frame can validate an instrument. It cannot turn a failed isolation gate into a fractional quantum Hall result, establish a thermodynamic phase, or support an architectural or cognitive claim.
